r.경제 체제: Livestock and remittances · mobile money widely used
r.한국이 파는 것: Batteries 37%, Tobacco 24%, Machinery, computers 10%, Organic chemicals 9% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Copper 63%, Fish and seafood 16%, Aluminum 11%, Animal and vegetable oils 9% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: The federal government is fighting the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab. Somaliland in the north has declared independence.

t.why: International navies operated off its coast for years against piracy in the Gulf of Aden.
t.rel: Somaliland in the north has declared independence and governs itself; in 2025 Israel became the first country to recognize it. Somalia fights the Islamist group al-Shabaab with support from African Union troops, and there is tension with Ethiopia, which wants access to the sea.
t.korea: Korea's foreign ministry has placed it under a level-4 travel ban. In 2011 Korea's Cheonghae unit rescued the crew of the Samho Jewelry from pirates.
t.know: Somalia has the longest coastline of any country on the African mainland.
t.etext: Livestock exports and diaspora remittances are the base of the economy. Mobile money is more widely used than banks. Long civil war has left the state weak.
